answer: Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent burns only once. The identity then has to pass a nebula challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next ridge. Registration demands a proof of work of 24 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the wharf. That is 40 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
